vol2.title: 2026-27 Proposed Budget, Volume 2: Individual School Reports (updated May 6, 2026)

resources.label: Local property taxes
resources.note: PPS's permanent tax rate of $5.28 per $1,000 of assessed value.

resources.label: State School Fund and other state
resources.note: Oregon's per-student school funding, weighted for students with higher needs.

resources.label: Local option levy
resources.note: A voter-approved extra property tax ($1.99 per $1,000), renewed in May 2024.

resources.label: Carryover from last year
resources.note: Money left at the end of 2025-26 (the beginning fund balance).

resources.label: Other local revenue
resources.note: Fees, rentals, interest, and similar local income.

resources.label: County education service district
resources.note: Pass-through money from the Multnomah Education Service District.

resources.label: Other
resources.note: Federal money, transfers from other funds, and other small sources.

uses.label: Instruction
uses.note: Teachers, classroom aides, and classroom costs.

uses.label: Support services
uses.note: Everything that keeps schools running outside the classroom.

uses.label: Other
uses.note: Money set aside or moved to other PPS funds.

all_funds.label: Construction and capital projects (mostly voter-approved bonds)

groups.label: Student transportation
groups.note: Contracted school buses and taxis, TriMet passes, and field trips.

groups.label: Payments to charter schools
groups.note: Money PPS passes to the charter schools it sponsors for the students they serve.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.note: Electricity, heating fuel, water and sewer, and garbage.

groups.label: Building repairs and property services
groups.note: Outside repair and maintenance work, rentals, and other property services.

groups.label: Tuition to other schools
groups.note: Tuition PPS pays to private schools and other agencies that serve its students.

groups.label: Instruction and training services
groups.note: Outside providers for teaching, program improvement, and staff training.

groups.label: Professional services
groups.note: Consultants, legal, audit, security, and other specialized outside services.

groups.label: Travel, phone, postage, and printing
groups.note: Staff and student travel, communications, and printing.
